title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We're excited to officially launch Spyglass, delivering powerful new insights and capabilities to all users.

title: Powerful File Management for Your Content
summary: Now you can effortlessly manage, upload, and customize how your files appear directly within the editor, giving you unprecedented control over your content.

title: Discover Our New Public Product Roadmap
summary: Explore our brand new public roadmap page to effortlessly keep up with our latest achievements, discover upcoming features, and get a sneak peek at what's planned for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a significantly improved checkbox experience with bigger, easier-to-click, and draggable checkboxes that seamlessly blend with our modern design.

title: Enhanced Live Collaboration
summary: Experience seamless teamwork with our enhanced editor, designed to make real-time collaboration effortless and more intuitive.

title: Seamless Discovery and Collaboration
summary: Now, effortlessly find and collaborate on shared content through enhanced search and integrated views, ensuring all relevant items are always within reach.

title: Enhanced Global Language Capabilities
summary: We're thrilled to introduce comprehensive international language support, making Noeko more accessible and powerful for users worldwide.

title: Unlocking Noeko: Open Source for Maximum Control
summary: We are proud to open-source Noeko, empowering our community with unprecedented control, transparency, and the opportunity to directly shape the future of the project.

title: Interactive Knowledge Map
summary: Unlock the full potential of your knowledge map with powerful new filtering and sharing capabilities, transforming it into an indispensable tool for discovery and workflow.

title: Dynamic Search and Curated Collections
summary: Empower your knowledge discovery with dynamic new filters that allow you to precisely narrow down results and save your custom searches as curated collections for instant access.

title: Dynamic Content Views
summary: Experience a more fluid and organized workflow by dynamically displaying and interacting with your linked content, including ideas, tasks, and sources, right within your notes.

title: Empower Your Workflow: Noeko Self-Hosting and Flexible Enterprise Plans
summary: Experience greater control and unlock advanced capabilities with Noeko's new self-hosting option and tailored enterprise plans, designed to fit your unique needs.

title: Vibrant New Themes and Refined Classics
summary: Discover a refreshed visual experience with polished existing themes and an exciting array of brand new designs to personalize your interface.

title: Perfecting Your Personalized Greetings
summary: We're ensuring your homepage always greets you with the correct time-of-day message, providing a consistently welcoming and accurate experience.

title: Effortless Tag Organization
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged items with new direct actions, allowing you to unapply tags and organize content faster than ever before.

title: Unlock More Content Types
summary: Seamlessly integrate and interact with a richer array of content, from YouTube videos to websites and text, transforming how you capture and connect your insights.
